item.title: Scammers targeting Allen County residents following winter storm
item.description: SCOTTSVILLE, Ky. – The Allen County Sheriff’s Office is warning county residents about a scam. ACSO says it is receiving phone calls about scammers who are claiming to be businesses and contractors offering services. The scammers tell residents that FEMA will pay for the services.
